parameters.name: CloudResourceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the connected resource, which is automatically generated by WAF in cloud native mode.

> You can call [CreateCloudResource](~~2839876~~) to connect a resource and then view the resource ID in the response.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token for the next page. If a value is returned for this parameter, the next page exists.
> If this parameter has a return value, the next page exists. You can use the returned **NextToken** value as a request parameter to obtain the next page of data. Repeat this process until no value is returned, which indicates that all data has been retrieved.

parameters.name: OwnerUserId
parameters.description: The UID of the resource ownership user.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The port of the cloud service connected to WAF.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceDomain
parameters.description:
The domain name connected to WAF.
> This parameter is supported only when the cloud service type is ddos.

parameters.name: ResourceInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the resource.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: ResourceProduct
parameters.description:
The cloud service to which the resource belongs. Valid values:

- **alb**: Application Load Balancer (ALB).

- **mse**: Microservices Engine (MSE).

- **fc**: Function Compute (FC).

- **sae**: Serverless App Engine (SAE).

- **ecs**: Elastic Compute Service (ECS).
- **clb4**: Classic Load Balancer (CLB) (TCP).
- **clb7**: Classic Load Balancer (CLB) (HTTP/HTTPS).
- **apig**: API Gateway (APIG).
- **nlb**: Network Load Balancer (NLB).
- **ddos**: Anti-DDoS.

> Different products are supported in different regions. If you specify a value for this parameter, make sure that the product is supported in the specified region. Otherwise, the query may fail.
